items.structure: Hard palate: palatine process of maxillae and palatine bone
items.note: Palatine processes of maxillae and horizontal plates of palatine bones are landmarks on the whole bones
items.custom_note: Bony roof of the mouth: the palatine processes of both maxillae (front 2/3) and the horizontal plates of both palatine bones (back 1/3), cut from the whole-bone meshes as the thin medial plate between the alveolar arches.

items.note: Soft palate itself (aponeurosis/mucosa) not modeled; approximated by its muscles: levator/tensor veli palatini, musculus uvulae, palatopharyngeus (R then L)
items.custom_note: Muscular-aponeurotic flap from the posterior border of the hard palate (palatine bones FJ3379/FJ3273) back to the uvula, between the palatoglossal/palatopharyngeal arches; contains the levator/tensor veli palatini, musculus uvulae and palatopharyngeus insertions.

items.note: Only the uvular muscle exists; uvula mucosal body not modeled
items.custom_note: Conical process hanging from the free posterior margin of the soft palate, enclosing the musculus uvulae (FJ2762).

items.note: No tonsil parts; would sit in tonsillar fossa in front of palatopharyngeus (bodyparts FJ2755/FJ2743)
items.custom_note: Lymphoid masses in the tonsillar fossae of the lateral oropharyngeal wall, between the palatoglossal arch (palatoglossus) in front and the palatopharyngeal arch (palatopharyngeus FJ2755/FJ2743) behind, below the soft palate.

items.note: Parotid duct not modeled; runs over masseter (SRC_Z_SUPERFICIAL_PART_OF_MASSETER_R/_L) and pierces buccinator (absent)
items.custom_note: Stensen's duct: from the anterior border of the parotid forward across the lateral surface of the masseter about a finger-breadth below the zygomatic arch, turning medially at its anterior border to pierce the buccinator and open opposite the upper second molar.

items.note: Parotid gland not modeled; lies over masseter/ramus (SRC_Z_SUPERFICIAL_PART_OF_MASSETER_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Largest salivary gland: superficial part over the posterior masseter, wrapping behind the mandibular ramus (retromandibular part) in front of the sternocleidomastoid, deep tip toward the styloid; from below the zygomatic arch to the angle of the mandible.

items.note: Submandibular duct not modeled; would arise from bodyparts FJ2768/FJ2766
items.custom_note: Wharton's duct: from the deep part of the submandibular gland (FJ2768/FJ2766) forward between mylohyoid and hyoglossus/genioglossus, medial to the sublingual gland, to the sublingual caruncle beside the frenulum.

items.note: Buccinator muscle not in either model
items.custom_note: Quadrilateral cheek muscle from the pterygomandibular raphe (FJ2756/FJ2744) and the alveolar processes of the maxilla and mandible opposite the molars, running forward lateral to the teeth/gums to the modiolus at the angle of the mouth.

items.note: Styloglossus not in either model
items.custom_note: From the styloid process (top of the stylohyoid ligament FJ2764/FJ2763) anteroinferiorly to the side of the tongue (FJ2761), running forward along its lateral margin above the hyoglossus.

items.note: Palatoglossus not in either model
items.custom_note: From the oral surface of the soft palate down the palatoglossal arch (anterior pillar of the fauces, in front of the palatine tonsil) to the side of the posterior tongue (FJ2761).

items.structure: Muscles of mastication: masseter, temporalis, medial pterygoid, lateral pterygoid
items.note: Masseter = superficial+deep parts; lateral pterygoid = superior+inferior heads
Lingual nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: Branch of V3: from below foramen ovale between the lateral and medial pterygoids, down on the medial pterygoid, against the mandible just below/behind the last molar, then forward on the hyoglossus (looping under the submandibular duct) into the anterior two-thirds of the tongue.

items.note: Hypoglossal nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: From the hypoglossal canal down between the internal carotid artery and internal jugular vein, deep to the posterior digastric, curving forward across the carotid arteries above the hyoid onto the lateral surface of the hyoglossus (below the lingual nerve) into the tongue muscles.

items.note: Facial nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: Extracranial facial nerve: from the stylomastoid foramen (between styloid and mastoid) forward into the parotid gland, dividing into temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular and cervical branches that fan out over the masseter and face.

items.note: Only ophthalmic division (V1, with its orbital branches) exists; trigeminal ganglion, V2, V3 absent
items.custom_note: Adds what the donor lacks to its ophthalmic division (V1, FJ1363/FJ1312): the trigeminal ganglion at the petrous apex with the sensory root to the pons, the maxillary division (V2) through foramen rotundum and the orbital floor to the infraorbital foramen, and the mandibular division (V3) through foramen ovale to the mandibular foramen, with its lingual branch.

items.note: Greater omentum not modeled; would hang from greater curvature of stomach FJ2564 to transverse colon FJ2572 (taenia omentalis FJ2570)
items.custom_note: Apron hanging from the greater curvature of the stomach (FJ2564) in front of the transverse colon (FJ2572) and small intestine, down to about the pelvic brim (anterior layer shown; the posterior layer returns to the transverse colon).

items.note: Lesser omentum not modeled; between lesser curvature of stomach FJ2564/duodenum FJ2573 and liver
items.custom_note: Double peritoneal sheet from the lesser curvature of the stomach and 1st part of the duodenum to the liver (hepatogastric + hepatoduodenal ligaments).

items.note: Not modeled; free edge of lesser omentum around portal vein FJ1853 and hepatic artery proper FJ3081 (bile duct absent)
items.custom_note: Right, thickened part of the lesser omentum: from the superior border of the 1st part of the duodenum (FJ2573) to the porta hepatis, its free edge enclosing the portal vein, hepatic artery proper and bile duct.

items.note: Not modeled; from lesser curvature of stomach FJ2564 to liver
items.custom_note: Part of the lesser omentum: thin sheet from the lesser curvature of the stomach (FJ2564) up to the fissure for the ligamentum venosum and porta hepatis of the liver.

items.note: Mesentery of small intestine (transverse mesocolon FJ3398 and mesoappendix FJ3397 also exist)
Falciform ligament not modeled; on anterior liver between segment IV (FJ2820) and II/III (FJ2818/FJ2819)
items.custom_note: Sickle-shaped sagittal fold from the anterior abdominal wall above the umbilicus and the diaphragm to the anterior-superior liver surface, along the line between segment IV and the left lobe (II/III); its free lower edge carries the ligamentum teres.

items.structure: Ligamentum teres (round ligament of the liver)
items.note: Ligamentum teres hepatis not modeled; free edge of falciform ligament (absent), umbilical fissure of liver
items.custom_note: Obliterated umbilical vein: from the umbilicus up the free edge of the falciform ligament, under the liver's inferior border into the umbilical fissure to the left branch of the portal vein (FJ1893).

items.note: Coronary ligament not modeled; peritoneal reflection from superior liver (segments VII/VIII FJ2409/FJ2823) to diaphragm
items.custom_note: Peritoneal reflection from the diaphragm onto the posterior right lobe: inferior and superior layers bounding the bare area (beside the IVC groove), meeting laterally at the right triangular ligament; the superior layer continues to the left as the start of the left triangular ligament. Drawn as a cord along the reflection lines.

items.note: Peritoneal pouch between rectum FJ2571 and urinary bladder FJ3149
items.custom_note: Lowest peritoneal recess in the male: thin space on the anterior surface of the rectum (FJ2571), between it and the bladder (FJ3149), bottoming out just above the seminal vesicles (FJ3137/FJ3143).

items.note: Female space; uterus absent (male model); would lie between uterus and bladder FJ3149
items.custom_note: Peritoneal recess between the uterus and the bladder (bladder not modeled in this body).

items.note: Female space; uterus absent (male model); would lie between uterus and rectum FJ2571
items.custom_note: Deepest peritoneal recess, behind the cervix and posterior vaginal fornix, in front of the rectum.

items.note: Junction of esophagus FJ2563 and stomach FJ2564; not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Band straddling the junction of the esophagus and the cardia (Z-line region); not a separate part in the donor.

items.note: Cricopharyngeal part is the lowest portion of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor; not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Lowest (cricopharyngeal) part of the inferior pharyngeal constrictor, slung from the cricoid cartilage around the pharyngoesophageal junction: the upper esophageal sphincter.

items.note: Physiological sphincter at distal esophagus FJ2563 near stomach FJ2564; not modeled
items.custom_note: Physiological sphincter: shown as the distal ~3.5 cm of the esophagus down to the GEJ (surface patch).

items.structure: Stomach: cardia, fundus, body, antrum, pylorus
items.note: Single stomach mesh; cardia/fundus/body/antrum/pylorus regions not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Region of the single BodyParts3D stomach mesh, split by geodesic position between the cardiac orifice and the pylorus (surface patch over the stomach). Pylorus = last ~1.5 cm before the duodenum.

items.note: Angle between esophagus FJ2563 and fundus of stomach FJ2564; not modeled
items.custom_note: Patch at the acute notch between the left wall of the abdominal esophagus and the fundus.

items.structure: Small intestine: Duodenum (All 4 parts), Jejunum, Ileum
items.note: Duodenum FJ2573 (its 4 parts not separated) + jejunum (23 pieces) + ileum (31 pieces)

items.structure: Large intestine: colon, rectum, anal canal
items.note: Ascending/transverse/descending colon + rectum exist; cecum, sigmoid colon and anal canal not modeled (ileocecal junction FJ2599 present)
items.custom_note: S-shaped loop from the pelvic brim to the rectum: the lower, medially-swinging part of the BodyParts3D descending-colon mesh (which runs on to the rectum).

items.structure: Colon: Cecum, ascending colon, transverse colon, descending colon, sigmoid colon
items.note: Cecum and sigmoid colon not modeled (ileocecal junction FJ2599 present)
items.custom_note: S-shaped loop from the pelvic brim to the rectum: the lower, medially-swinging part of the BodyParts3D descending-colon mesh (which runs on to the rectum).

items.note: Right flexure = ascending FJ2566/transverse FJ2572 junction; left = transverse FJ2572/descending FJ2567 junction
items.custom_note: Right (hepatic) flexure = ascending/transverse colon bend; left (splenic) flexure = transverse/descending bend. Patches on both colon meshes around each junction.

items.note: Taenia libera, mesocolica, omentalis
Haustra are sacculations of the colon wall; not separately modeled
Epiploic appendages are fat tags on the colon surface along the taeniae (FJ2568-FJ2570); not modeled
items.custom_note: Small peritoneal fat tags (appendices epiploicae) placed along the taenia omentalis and taenia libera of the ascending, transverse, descending and sigmoid colon; absent from cecum and rectum.

items.note: Anal canal absent; IAS would lie inside external anal sphincter (SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_ANAL_SPHINCTER_R/_L), below rectum FJ2571
items.custom_note: Thickened circular smooth muscle of the upper ~2/3 of the anal canal, just inside the external anal sphincter (FJ2543/FJ2548) and continuous with the rectal wall.

items.note: Anal opening not modeled; center of external anal sphincter (SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_ANAL_SPHINCTER_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Anal opening at the lower end of the anal canal, ringed by the subcutaneous external anal sphincter.

items.note: Anal canal absent; line would be inside the anal canal below rectum FJ2571, within EAS (SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_ANAL_SPHINCTER_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Ring on the inner wall of the anal canal about halfway down (inside the sphincters); internal line, shown as a thin ring on the canal wall.

items.note: Not in z-anatomy
Short gastric arteries not modeled; would arise from splenic artery SRC_Z_SPLENIC_ARTERY
items.custom_note: 4 small branches from the terminal splenic artery (FJ2562) near the splenic hilum, running in the gastrosplenic ligament to the fundus of the stomach (FJ2564).

items.note: Cystic artery not modeled; would arise from right hepatic artery (bodyparts FJ3117) to gallbladder FJ2817
items.custom_note: From the right hepatic artery (FJ3117) through the cystohepatic triangle to the neck and body of the gallbladder (FJ2817).

items.note: Anterior + posterior superior pancreaticoduodenal arteries (not in z-anatomy)
Anterior branch also exists: SRC_Z_ANTERIOR_INFERIOR_PANCREATICODUODENAL_ARTERY
z-anatomy has only the vein
z-anatomy has only the vein
Superior anorectal = superior rectal artery
Abdominal + thoracic parts
Vagus nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: Both vagus nerves from the jugular foramen down the carotid sheath (between internal jugular vein FJ3585 and carotid arteries), the right crossing in front of the right subclavian artery, the left over the aortic arch (FJ3411), both behind the main bronchi onto the esophagus (FJ2563) where they form the esophageal plexus.

items.note: Vagal trunks not modeled; would lie on esophagus FJ2563
items.custom_note: Anterior trunk (mainly left vagus) on the front of the distal esophagus through the hiatus to the anterior stomach along the lesser curvature; posterior trunk (mainly right vagus) on the back of the esophagus to the celiac plexus.

items.note: Celiac ganglia not modeled; around celiac trunk SRC_Z_COELIAC_TRUNK
items.custom_note: Paired irregular ganglia on the anterolateral aorta (FJ1932) either side of the celiac trunk (FJ1846), on the diaphragmatic crura; receive the greater splanchnic nerves.

items.note: Thoracic splanchnic nerves not modeled
items.custom_note: Bilateral greater (T5-T9 roots -> celiac ganglion), lesser (T10-T11 -> aorticorenal ganglion) and least (T12 -> renal plexus) splanchnic nerves, from the sympathetic trunk beside the thoracic vertebral bodies down onto the bodies and through the crura.

items.note: Lumbar splanchnic nerves not modeled
items.custom_note: Bilateral branches from the lumbar sympathetic trunk (on the anterolateral L1-L3 bodies, medial to psoas) running anteromedially to the aortic (intermesenteric) and inferior mesenteric plexus around the IMA origin (FJ3442).

items.note: Pelvic splanchnic nerves not modeled
items.custom_note: Bilateral parasympathetic branches from the S2-S4 anterior rami at the anterior sacral foramina (sacrum FJ3393), running anteromedially to the inferior hypogastric plexus on the side of the rectum (FJ2571).

items.structure: Liver lobes: right, left, caudate, quadrate
items.note: No lobe meshes except caudate FJ2816; liver is modeled as hepatovenous segments. Right lobe ~ V-VIII (FJ2821,FJ2822,FJ2409,FJ2823,FJ2824); left lobe ~ II/III (FJ2818,FJ2819); quadrate ~ segment IV (FJ2820, includes IVa); segment IX FJ1858 also exists
Hilum on visceral liver between quadrate (seg IV FJ2820) and caudate FJ2816; transmits portal vein FJ1853, hepatic artery proper FJ3081, hepatic ducts FJ3123/FJ3096
items.custom_note: Hilum on the visceral surface of the liver between the quadrate (seg IV) and caudate lobes, where the portal vein FJ1853, hepatic artery proper FJ3081 and hepatic ducts enter/leave: patch on the liver segments around them.

items.structure: Hepatic arteries: left and right hepatic arteries
items.note: Trunks of right and left hepatic arteries (not in z-anatomy)

items.structure: Hepatic veins: left, middle, and right hepatic veins
items.note: Right, middle, left hepatic veins
Single gallbladder mesh; body/fundus/neck not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Region of the single BodyParts3D gallbladder mesh along its long axis (surface patch). Neck = tapered end continuing into the cystic duct (FJ3080).

items.note: Right then left hepatic duct
Common bile duct not modeled; would continue from common hepatic duct FJ3079 + cystic duct FJ3080 to duodenum FJ2573
items.custom_note: From the union of the common hepatic and cystic ducts down behind the 1st part of the duodenum and through the pancreatic head to the 2nd part. In BodyParts3D this course is the lower part of the 'Common hepatic duct' mesh FJ3079; built as a sleeve over that part.

items.note: Pancreatic duct (duct tree FJ2630 also exists)
Not modeled; union of pancreatic duct FJ1896 and (absent) CBD within the duodenal wall FJ2573
items.custom_note: Hepatopancreatic ampulla: small dilation where the CBD (FJ3079) and main pancreatic duct (FJ1896) end, within the posteromedial wall of the 2nd part of the duodenum.

items.note: Papilla on medial wall of descending duodenum FJ2573; not modeled
items.custom_note: Patch of the posteromedial wall of the descending (2nd) duodenum where the ampulla opens; the papilla is a mucosal mound on the inner wall, shown here as the matching wall region.

items.note: Single pancreas mesh (parenchyma FJ2629 also exists); head/neck/body/tail not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Region of the single BodyParts3D pancreas mesh (surface patch). Tail = lateral end reaching toward the splenic hilum.

items.note: Rectus sheath not modeled; envelops rectus abdominis SRC_Z_RECTUS_ABDOMINIS_MUSCLE_R/_L, formed by EO/IO/TA aponeuroses
items.custom_note: Aponeurotic sheath of rectus abdominis (EO/IO/TA aponeuroses): anterior layer along the whole muscle, posterior layer only above the arcuate line (about a third of the way from umbilicus to pubis); below it the muscle lies on the transversalis fascia.

items.note: Not in z-anatomy
Transversalis fascia not modeled; deep to transversus abdominis SRC_Z_TRANSVERSUS_ABDOMINIS_MUSCLE_R/_L
items.custom_note: Fascial lining on the deep surface of transversus abdominis (and behind rectus below the arcuate line), between the muscles and the extraperitoneal fat; the deep inguinal ring is an opening in it.

items.note: Aponeurosis not a separate part; anteroinferior portion of the external oblique muscle (only if the mesh includes it)
items.custom_note: Tendinous anteromedial part of the external oblique, medial to a line from the 9th costal cartilage region to the ASIS; forms the anterior rectus sheath, the inguinal ligament and the superficial inguinal ring.

items.note: Superficial fatty fascia not modeled; superficial to external oblique SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_ABDOMINAL_OBLIQUE_MUSCLE_R/_L
items.custom_note: Superficial fatty layer of the superficial fascia over the anterior abdominal wall, outside Scarpa's fascia.

items.note: Membranous superficial fascia not modeled; superficial to external oblique SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_ABDOMINAL_OBLIQUE_MUSCLE_R/_L
items.custom_note: Deep membranous layer of the superficial fascia of the lower anterior abdominal wall (below the umbilicus), superficial to the external oblique aponeurosis; continuous with Colles' fascia of the perineum.

items.structure: Femoral triangle: inguinal ligament, sartorius muscle, adductor longus muscle
items.note: Triangle is a space; sartorius and adductor longus borders exist, inguinal ligament absent (ASIS to pubic tubercle on SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Rolled-under lower border of the external oblique aponeurosis from the anterior superior iliac spine to the pubic tubercle (hip bone landmarks); a border of both the femoral and inguinal triangles.

items.structure: Inguinal canal: deep inguinal ring & superficial inguinal ring
items.note: Canal and deep/superficial rings not modeled; oblique passage through EO/IO/TA (SRC_Z_EXTERNAL_/INTERNAL_ABDOMINAL_OBLIQUE_MUSCLE, SRC_Z_TRANSVERSUS_ABDOMINIS_MUSCLE) above the inguinal ligament (absent)
items.custom_note: Oblique passage ~1 cm above and parallel to the medial half of the inguinal ligament, from the deep ring (above the ligament's midpoint, lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels) to the superficial ring (above the pubic tubercle); both rings shown as small loops at its ends.

items.structure: Inguinal triangle: rectus abdominis, inferior epigastric vessels, and inguinal ligament
items.note: Triangle is a space; rectus abdominis and inferior epigastric vessels exist, inguinal ligament absent
items.custom_note: Hesselbach's triangle on the inner surface of the anterior abdominal wall: bounded by the lateral border of rectus abdominis, the inferior epigastric vessels and the inguinal ligament (site of direct inguinal hernia).

items.structure: Femoral sheath: femoral vein, femoral artery, and lymphatics
items.note: Sheath itself and its lymphatics/nodes not modeled; femoral artery and vein exist
items.custom_note: Funnel of fascia below the inguinal ligament enclosing the femoral artery (lateral), femoral vein (middle) and femoral canal with lymphatics (medial); ends ~3 cm down. The real artery and vein remain part of the answer.

items.note: Femoral canal is a space medial to femoral vein SRC_Z_FEMORAL_VEIN_R/_L within the (absent) femoral sheath
items.custom_note: Medial compartment of the femoral sheath, medial to the femoral vein, from the femoral ring under the inguinal ligament down ~1.5 cm; contains lymphatics and the deep inguinal (Cloquet's) node.

items.note: Femoral nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: From the lumbar plexus (L2-L4) within psoas, emerging at its lateral border, running in the groove between psoas and iliacus, under the inguinal ligament lateral to the femoral artery (outside the sheath), and dividing in the femoral triangle.

items.note: Ilioinguinal nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: L1: below the iliohypogastric across quadratus lumborum, through the wall near the ASIS, then through the inguinal canal and out of the superficial ring to the scrotum/medial thigh.

items.note: Iliohypogastric nerve not modeled
items.custom_note: L1: from the lateral border of psoas across the front of quadratus lumborum, through transversus abdominis above the iliac crest, forward between transversus and internal oblique, then medial above the ASIS to the suprapubic skin.

items.note: ASIS is a landmark on the hip bone (ilium)
items.custom_note: Anterior end of the iliac crest (both hip bones); upper attachment of the inguinal ligament and sartorius.

items.note: Pubic crest is a landmark on the hip bone (pubis)
items.custom_note: Thickened superior border of the body of the pubis, from the pubic tubercle medially toward the symphysis (both sides).

items.note: Right and left crura are parts of the single diaphragm mesh; not separated
items.custom_note: Right and left crura: the tendinous/muscular columns of the lumbar part of the diaphragm descending onto the upper lumbar vertebral bodies, arching over the aorta (median arcuate ligament).

items.note: Central tendon is part of the single diaphragm mesh; not separated
items.custom_note: Trefoil aponeurosis at the summit of the diaphragm, between the domes, fused with the pericardium above; the caval opening passes through it.

items.note: Opening in central tendon of diaphragm; transmits IVC SRC_Z_INFERIOR_VENA_CAVA_THORACIC_PART
items.custom_note: Opening in the central tendon at T8 transmitting the IVC (SRC_Z_INFERIOR_VENA_CAVA_THORACIC_PART): the ring of diaphragm around the vein.

items.note: Opening in right crus of diaphragm; transmits esophagus (bodyparts FJ2563)
items.custom_note: Opening at T10 in the muscular part formed by the right crus, left of the midline and in front of the aortic hiatus; transmits the esophagus and vagal trunks (esophagus is not in this donor - ring shown).

items.note: Opening behind median arcuate ligament of diaphragm; transmits aorta (SRC_Z_THORACIC_AORTA / SRC_Z_ABDOMINAL_AORTA)
items.custom_note: Opening at T12 behind the median arcuate ligament between the crura, transmitting the aorta (SRC_Z_THORACIC_AORTA/SRC_Z_ABDOMINAL_AORTA) and thoracic duct: the crural arch around the aorta.

items.note: Cord coverings, cremaster and pampiniform plexus not modeled; contents present: deferent ducts and testicular artery/vein (R then L)
items.custom_note: Cord coverings (external/cremasteric/internal spermatic fascia) as a sheath around the deferent duct and testicular vessels from the deep inguinal ring through the inguinal canal to the top of the testis; the real duct and vessels remain part of the answer.

items.note: Female structure; uterus absent in male model; would run through the (absent) inguinal canal
items.custom_note: Same mesh as the Repro class: uterine horn to the deep inguinal ring.
